d:
Priy vyuars,
Hamare sanvidhan ke sabse mahattvapurn anuchchhedon men se ek hai : anuchchhed 21; aur iske sanbandh men aapne 'vidhi dvara sthapit prakriya' (Procedure established by law) tatha 'yathochit vidhi prakriya' (Due process of law) ki prasiddh dibet suni hi hogi. isi prakar, anuchchhed 22 ka sanbandh giraphtariyon tatha nivarak nirodh (Preventive Detention) jaise vishyon se hai.
